name: Dynamic Semantic Human NeRF
definition: Extension to model dynamic human motion by learning a consistent continuous function Gω for geometry and appearance variations across frames, using imGHUM to warp observations into a canonical reference frame and provide spatial-temporal correspondences.
summary: Dynamic Semantic Human NeRF renders humans in arbitrary poses and shapes from sparse video by warping observations into a canonical frame using imGHUM and residual SDFs for fine-grained deformation.
